scope: W01-W06 actual Windows OS feasibility in both Dear ImGui launch modes on one machine, using immutable qualified P06c3 Min products. No platform/release acceptance, new inventory or product rebuild.
identity_policy: Revalidate all pins before setup/each launch. No primary mutable-cache product. New machine/OS observations bind P06c3 without relabelling previous P05l inventory or rerunning Min parity.

fixture_preparation.effects: When root executes: import pinned core/NumPy, materialize3literal nativeV3 fixtures, pin exact encoded bytes and verify raw roundtrip. No window/install/product qualification. Not executed.
fixture_preparation.first_command_powershell:
@'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,time,traceback
root=Path.cwd().resolve();cp=root/'docs/parity/reviews/windows-platform-workload-contract-001.json'
c=json.loads(cp.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
base=root/'build/windows-workload-001';base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
started=base/'prepare-001.started.json';final=base/'prepare-001.final.json'
if started.exists() or final.exists():raise RuntimeError('Fresh attempt required; preserve existing preparation')
r={'id':'windows-workload.fixture-supervisor.001','state':'started','contract_sha256':hashlib.sha256(cp.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'timeout_seconds':120,'visible_launches':0}
with started.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2)
t=time.monotonic()
try:
    done=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-X','utf8','-B','-c',c['fixture_preparation']['python_source']],timeout=120,capture_output=True)
    (base/'prepare-001.stdout').write_bytes(done.stdout);(base/'prepare-001.stderr').write_bytes(done.stderr)
    r['exit_code']=done.returncode
    if done.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Preparation child failed; retain stdout/stderr')
    r['state']='prepared_fixtures_only_no_platform_execution'
except BaseException as e:
    r['state']='failed';r['error']=repr(e);r['traceback']=traceback.format_exc()
    raise
finally:
    r['elapsed_seconds']=time.monotonic()-t
    with final.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2)
print(json.dumps(r))
'@ | & 'build/p06c3-env-ui001/Scripts/python.exe' -I -X utf8 -B -

launch_policy: Fresh per-context working/config directories contain any imgui.ini. No hidden/frames/smoke/headless/consumer flags. Resolve argv absolutely and preserve original user settings.

actions: Launch visible using pinned argv. Await owned GLFW HWND; record PID/TID/creationtime/HWND/class/owner/rect/visibility/foreground and loaded modules.
Send actual Alt+Tab between product and one runner-owned neutral Win32 window,3roundtrips. Record actual focus changes and release injected modifiers.
Send Ctrl+O to focused product; record native Open dialog HWND/owner, then physical Escape. Observe Gaussian ImGui form separately; it is not an OS HWND modal.
Close clean product with Alt+F4 and await normal exit; reopen once with same owned preferences/literal inputs.
required_evidence: QPC request/acknowledgment timestamps; tagged SendInput arrays/count/error and matching low-level injected events.
SetWinEventHook foreground/focus/show/hide/destroy plus GetGUIThreadInfo; exact owned-PID identity, not title matching alone.
Owned-window visible screenshots; native dialog GW_OWNER relation. Actual GL strings remain unobserved without G01.
workload.completion: Observed startup/focus/dialog/cancel/shutdown only. A visible window or loaded OpenGL DLL does not establish actual context/vendor/adapter.

actions: On F01 physically open Process > Filters > Gaussian blur (gaussian_blur); set sigma0.85, nearest border, preview-ready/cancel3times, then one actual Apply, Save Document and Undo.

In the real scalar field type raw partial "-", then "1.25". With field focus send Left/Right and Ctrl+Z; verify field edits cause no document navigation/pixel action. Escape closes form before canvas keys.
Create rectangle from image-cell(4,4) to(14,12) through OS press/move/release using the actually observed visible image transform, then physical File > Save document.

On F02 use physical T/C/Z fields through [[1,1,2],[1,2,2],[0,2,2],[0,2,3],[1,1,2]]; toggle XYZ; focus XY then Right, XZ then Up, YZ then Right (each keydown50ms/keyup); return to captured position through actual fields. Check linked view outcomes against the preserved qualified keyboard contract,not a new inferred key mapping.
required_evidence: Pre/post captures/control crops plus raw input/focus ledger. Locate by root-approved visible rectangles or available UIA; no headless IDs or guessed geometry.

Physically saved nativeV3 checkpoints prove published pixels/calibration/selection; decode only closed files with pinned core. Save/Open does not persist undo/redo history or transient preview/camera focus. Actual Undo and enabled menu state are observed separately; exact live revisions/history need G02.
Native HWND focus does not prove ImGui InputText ownership. Require visible caret/text, UIA semantics if available, or G02.
workload.completion: No physical input credit from Editor.action/set_view/render_headless. Missing transform/widget/preview proof is observation-limited and requires G02, never reduced assertions.

actions: Observe actual monitors/work areas and target/runner DPI awareness. Move/resize same owned window toward centered1280x820 logical size on each available monitor and back,twice; explicitly clamp to that workarea minus16physical-pixel margins and record requested/actual sizes.
At each position record window/client physical rectangles/DPI, then click same visible menu and a64x48 fixture landmark derived from that capture.
required_evidence: A96DPI return from an unaware window is not evidence of96physical-monitor DPI. Do not change machine scale or infer monitors from adapter inventory.
workload.completion: Only observed monitor/DPI combinations. Mixed-DPI stays open if unavailable; clipping, unreadability and hit-target drift are defects.

actions: Windows PowerShell UIAutomationClient/UIAutomationTypes inspects owned HWND raw/control trees in4states: menu, focused Gaussian scalar, image canvas, native Open dialog.
Record per-element name/type/automationID/HWND/value/patterns/bounds/enabled/offscreen/focus. Separately attempt Narrator keyboard traversal in those4states; record actual utterances and inputs.
required_evidence: A generic GLFW pane or missing child semantic tree is an actual unsupported capability, not accessibility success.
Narrator needs exact operator-heard transcript/observer identity or explicit unobserved result. UIA does not prove speech. Do not control a pre-existing user Narrator instance.
workload.completion: Observed semantic/focus/announcement evidence per state; negative feasibility remains an open capability. No cross-machine accessibility claim.

actions: Physically Select All(Ctrl+A) then Copy(Ctrl+C) on F01 activeXY; observe clipboardsequence and CF_DIB in runner-owned neutral helper. Publish literal8x6RGB DIB from helper,actual Edit > Paste as new image,Save Document and inspect exact pixels.
Ctrl+O opens copied fixture through native Open; physical Save Document to ownedUnicode path, then native dialog reopen.
File > Print opens native PrintDlgW. Select only Microsoft Print to PDF if available and save in owned stage. If that exact printer is unavailable,cancel; never select a physical printer.
required_evidence: CF_DIB header/stride/orientation/pixels parsed independently; raw clipboardsequence/openowner linked to physical action.
Actual file dialog HWND/class/owner, typedUnicode paths and output byte identities. Direct Editor open/save API is not evidence.
Actual printer selection/dialog events/PDF hash/page extent and rendered owned-content comparison. App PDF export is not Windows print.
workload.completion: Clipboard/native dialogs/printing have independent evidence. Unavailable printer/command remains open. No pre-existing clipboard payload is read or persisted.

actions: One unmeasured warmup;10fixed F02navigationcycles(the5W02positions),10F03 sigma0.85/nearest preview-ready/cancelcycles,then3actual Apply/Undo pairs. Keep history-retaining Apply phase separate from cancel-only memory.
Sample exact owned PID WorkingSet/PrivateUsage every100ms from first ready to exit. Enumerate actual loaded module paths/version/hash at first ready and after cycles.
Record attributable GPU Process Memory PID/LUID counters if available; otherwise retain missing-attribution outcome.
required_evidence: QPC input-ack to first observed stable visual state;20Hz capture around events,report50ms resolution/occlusion limits. Not CPU API timing.
PSAPI PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX WorkingSetSize/PeakWorkingSetSize/PrivateUsage and sampled PrivateUsage peak. SystemfreeRAM/estimatedarrays are not process usage.
Raw GPUProcessMemory counter instancePID/LUID linkage only; no whole-cardVRAM or runner-process DXGI result attributed to product.
Toolhelp/PSAPI resolved modules/version/hash are observed runtime facts; historic compiler invocation remains separately sourced.
workload.completion: Individual samples and median/nearest-rankp95/max by launch. Missing endpoint/counter remains missing; no algorithm/volume benchmark claim.

clipboard_literal.independent_helper: No product imports. The helper writes literal CF_DIB and reads owned returned CF_DIB; it is a separate owned process,not another user app.
clipboard_literal.copy_direction_policy: F01 Copy crosses rendered8-bit display/CF_DIB,not rawU16. Compare returned DIB to the observed physically exported display under the same source/view and reuse qualified rendering semantics separately. Helper-to-editor Paste independently requires exact literal RGB bytes above. Preserve F01 source bits.

metric_contract.ratification: Root approval ratifies these first-workload feasibility budgets only,not universal release budgets. Missing endpoints are not zero latency.
metric_contract.samples: 1warmup,10navigation/preview cycles,3Apply/Undo pairs percontext; keep every sample,median,nearest-rankp95,max; no poolinglaunches.

definitions.startup: CreateProcess/Popen completion to first visible owned foreground nonblank/stable client capture.
definitions.navigation: Tagged injected-event acknowledgment to capture showing requested control/image state at20Hz; report50ms granularity.
definitions.preview: Last actual parameter/Preview event ack to first visible READY preview; busy=false alone does not prove source attribution.
definitions.apply: Actual Apply ack to committed picture/state linked to physical Save Document or G02.
definitions.shutdown: Alt+F4/accepted close-confirm ack to terminal process exit.

metric_contract.memory_baseline: Median10samples in1s at initial ready after warmup; cancel-only delta uses median10samples after10thcancel+1ssettle. Apply/undo/history phase separate. Name native PeakWorkingSet and sampled peaks separately.
metric_contract.gpu: No threshold without attributable counters. Observed values or missing capability only.

win32_protocol.input: SendInput with correct pointer-width INPUT layouts/sizeof,scan codes or KEYEVENTF_UNICODE,taggeddwExtraInfo,absolute virtual-desktop mouse coordinates including negative monitor origin. Record request/count/error/QPC and matching WH_KEYBOARD_LL/WH_MOUSE_LL injected events. No PostMessage keyboard/mouse or ImGui input API.
win32_protocol.foreground: Exact launched PID+creationtime/HWND; verify GetForegroundWindow before every input and stop subcheck on mismatch. SetForegroundWindow failure is a finding; no blind input to user windows.
win32_protocol.focus_observer: SetWinEventHook out-of-context plus GetGUIThreadInfo active/focus/capture/menu HWNDs,with messagepump and errors. These are OS facts,not internal ImGui focus.
win32_protocol.capture: GDI BitBlt/GetDIBits of owned visible foreground rectangle;recordQPC/rect/DPI/occlusion/SHA. No full-desktop or foreign-window capture. Black PrintWindow OpenGL image is not a visible screenshot.
win32_protocol.clipboard: Only owned testpayload via independent CF_DIB helper; do not inspect/serialize original clipboard. Sequence-number ownership prevents clearing a later user change.
win32_protocol.dialogs: Enumerate only product/native-modal PID,HWndclass,GW_OWNER and bounded UIA when supported. ImGui forms are not nativeHWNDdialogs.
win32_protocol.uia: WindowsPowerShell5.1 loads UIAutomationClient/UIAutomationTypes and AutomationElement.FromHandle; bounded raw/control trees. No thirdparty install or UIAInvoke substitute for physical SendInput.
win32_protocol.dpi: Record target/runner awareness and actual monitor/window rectangles/DPI. No scaling changes or adapter-mode inference.
win32_protocol.memory: PSAPI PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX,exact PID+creationtime,PSAPI/Toolhelp modulepaths,QPC. Missingpermission/API is explicit failure.
win32_protocol.gpu: Actual per-PID/LUID GPUProcessMemory counters if available. External DXGI QueryVideoMemoryInfo reports calling-process scope and cannot prove target usage.

assign/freeze one external Win32 observer driver and neutral helper against this contract; no second inventory
imgui_cpp W01-W06 sequentially, then imgui_python identical inputs/order
independently review exact observed/defect/unsupported/observation-limited subchecks and outputs
only root may adopt genuine platform/benchmark evidence; no automatic promotion

driver_prerequisite.scope: One stdlib ctypes Win32 observer + runner-owned neutral helper process; reuse existing bounded process-supervision patterns,not a general UI framework. Root must assign new file before implementation. No product math/UIA bridge/DLL injection.
driver_prerequisite.inputs: This exact contract hash and prepared fixture receipt. Freeze driver source/hash and exact raw schema before actual OS execution.
driver_prerequisite.existing_tool_decision: benchmark_desktop.py measures targeted native APIs without rendering; run_cpp_ui.ps1 may build and targets a mutable cache. Neither can supply OS events/focus/DPI/UIA/process observations. No suitable runner was found in scripts.

raw_outputs.index: Exact context/W01-W06/subcheck membership,status observed/defect/unsupported/observation-limited,paths/bytes/SHA. No producer PASS/expectedRGB. Adoption is independent.
raw_outputs.durability: Start/exactargv/environment/pins before spawn;append actual events;final or failed receipt retains originals. Parentwallclock/storage/depth caps failclosed. Never overwrite failed attempts.
raw_outputs.capture_policy: Capture owned window at selected checkpoints and ROI-only metric crops around events. Keep pre-response and first-response evidence; append timestamps/hashes/classification for intermediate observer polls. Freeze visible endpoint classifier before execution; if correct-state timing cannot be independently established,report response timing only or observation-limited,no fabricated correctness/latency pass.

lifecycle_and_cleanup.ownership: Record PID+creationtime/processhandle for every product/helper/newNarrator and original foreground. No process-name termination or controlling a pre-existing user editor/Narrator.
lifecycle_and_cleanup.normal: Release injected keys/buttons,cancel owned dialogs/jobs,use actual Cancel/Discard if dirty,Alt+F4,bounded wait;confirm process exit. No taskkill/name sweep.
lifecycle_and_cleanup.timeout: After10snormalcleanup,terminate only exact recorded owned product/helper or its kill-on-close Job;capture reason/exitcode and fail subcheck. Stop further input immediately on ownership/foreground loss.
lifecycle_and_cleanup.job: Prefer CreateProcess suspended,assign runner-owned JobObject then resume;or equivalent no-race ownership. Parent-job restrictions/assignment failure are explicit;no invented containment.
lifecycle_and_cleanup.clipboard: Set owned marker without reading original payload. Clear only if clipboardsequence still matches last runner write;preserve later user changes.
lifecycle_and_cleanup.filesystem: Preserve fixtures/rawcaptures/saved artifacts/terminal logs/failures/products. Delete only named owned scratch with no process/evidence consumer. No build/cache/source deletion.

observation_limits_and_source_needs.needed: Separately authorize read-only owning-render-thread export of glGetString vendor/renderer/version/GLSL,GLFW negotiated attributes,native HWND,content scale/framebuffer. Route optional report through RunOptions/window.hpp,main.cpp and python.cpp symmetrically. No input injection/renderer change. Any changed product needs matching qualification.
observation_limits_and_source_needs.first_workload: Mark GL context/activeadapter unobserved for immutableMin;loadedopengl32/windowpixels cannot prove them. Other external OS checks proceed.

observation_limits_and_source_needs.needed: If visible/UIA and physical Save Document cannot prove an exact required field/transform/job/preview/revision,add narrow owning-render-thread read-only frame observations in a separately authorized product change. Actual OS events remain the input source. No headless probe or cross-thread Editor calls.
observation_limits_and_source_needs.first_workload: Use visible captures and actual saved files. Mark unverifiable internal claims observation-limited;do not infer history/revisions from persisted sessions.

observation_limits_and_source_needs.source: qualified GLFW/OpenGL Window::run;headless cases have no UIA/Narrator qualification
observation_limits_and_source_needs.needed: A missing semantic UIA tree or Narrator announcements is a real product gap. Record exact perstate result before designing a bridge. This preparation neither implements nor invents a provider.

local_tool_observations.effects: Read file/archive bytes;stdlib ctypes checked named systemDLL exports only. No OS input,product import,window,GLcontext,capture,benchmark or product execution in this task.
local_tool_observations.limits: Export/file presence is not permission,functioning delivery,loadedproductmodule,UIA/Narrator result,effectiveDPI or graphics proof.

technical_sources.supports: NativeHWND active/focus/capture/menu facts,not ImGui semantic focus.
DPI depends on target awareness;96 may mean unaware.
Current-calling-process scope is not external product PID attribution.

next_root_action: Review/ratify frozen workload+limits;execute fixture_preparation.first_command_powershell once. Assign the one missing external OS driver against this exact contract;run independently observable startup/focus/dialog/DPI/UIA/process subset using preservedMin without waiting forG01/G02.
